title: Locality-aware mirror gatekeeping for usage streams
creator: Anika Shah
description:
Problem: Console usage events (api calls, token usage, route metrics) are currently streamed to a single primary analytics cluster and then fan-out replicated. That fan-out introduces compliance risk for customers who require that data never leave a specific region or legal jurisdiction.

Goal: Implement a locality-aware write gating and selective mirror mechanism so that tenant-scoped usage events are written only to permitted regional analytics clusters, and any cross-region replication is explicitly controlled by policy. The feature must preserve low-latency ingestion for the console, enable deterministic replay for downstream jobs, and provide audit trails for residency decisions.

High-level approach: 1) Introduce a Residency Policy Service (RPS) — a small config + policy store that maps tenant attributes (tenant region tag, contract geofence, legal-hold flags) to allowed target regions. 2) Implement a write-path gate in the analytics ingestion service that consults RPS synchronously (with cache) to decide whether to mirror, redirect, or drop outbound replication to other regions. 3) Add an async reconciliation pipeline that verifies eventual consistency and emits incidents when a tenant's data is observed outside allowed regions. 4) Expose control flags and audit logs in Console for enterprise admins to verify policy decisions.
acceptance_criteria: RPS deployed to prod with an initial seed policy and 99.9% read availability
Ingestion service consults RPS and routes tenant events to only allowed regional clusters (no accidental fan-out)
Reconciliation job detects cross-region replication within 1 hour of occurrence and creates an alert pipeline entry
Console shows per-tenant residency status and last violation timestamp
End-to-end latency for happy-path ingestion increases by <10% at p95
Automated test harness simulates 5K tenants across three regions covering policy permutations
progress_updates: 2025-02-10: Ticket created after executive review of compliance requirements for EMEA customers.
2025-02-12: Spike completed — RPS design options evaluated (Redis+Postgres hybrid vs. config-service backed by Spanner). Chosen: Postgres primary with Redis local cache for low-latency reads.
2025-02-14: Prototype gating logic implemented in ingestion service (feature branch: gh/eng/34721-local-gate). Added feature flag for synchronous consult vs cached fallback.
2025-02-18: First integration test passing in staging for single-tenant routing to EU-only cluster. Recorded p95 latency +6% under load test (baseline: 56ms -> 59ms).
2025-02-20: Reconciliation job PoC runs nightly; detected one historical tenant not tagged correctly — created task ENG-34754 to backfill tenant region tags.
2025-02-22: Security reviewed policy store schema. Need HSM/KMS integration for signing audit entries (follow-up: ENG-34769).
design_notes: Policy model: static allow-lists per tenant, with optional override windows (for short-term migrations). Policies stored as explicit region lists to simplify evaluation.
Cache strategy: local Redis per ingestion zone with TTL 60s and jittered refresh to avoid stampede. On cache miss, fallback consult Postgres with read-replica routing.
Consistency model: Strong for gate decisions (sync consult on cache miss) but eventual for reconciliation. Reconciliation uses transactional snapshots and object hashes to detect copies.
Fallback modes: 1) strict (reject cross-region writes), 2) advisory (allow but flag and escalate), 3) mirror (explicit cross-region mirror allowed). Default pilot mode = advisory.
Encryption & keys: Audit entries and policy change logs will be signed with KMS key; tenant PII stripped before mirror decisions. See security notes.
implementation_tasks: Add RPS Postgres schema + migration scripts (PR: gh/eng/repo/pulls/412)
Implement Redis cache adapter and LRU eviction with TTL jitter (branch: feature/rps-cache)
Add gating middleware to ingestion service with feature flag toggle (PR: gh/ingestion/pulls/1298)
Build reconciliation job in analytics pipeline (PR: gh/analytics/pulls/221)
Console UI: residency status widget and audit viewer (PR: gh/console/pulls/84)
Add e2e tests in CI that spin up 3 regional clusters using docker-compose presets
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Synchronous consults could increase write latency under cache pressure. Mitigation: aggressive caching, circuit-breaker to fallback to last-known-policy (advisory) and traffic shaping.
Risk: Mis-tagged tenants could cause data loss in strict mode. Mitigation: default to advisory for initial rollout and provide backfill tooling (ENG-34754).
Risk: Reconciliation false positives due to replication metadata differences. Mitigation: use canonical content hashing and tenant-scoped metadata matching before triggering alerts.
Risk: Policy store availability. Mitigation: deploy across regions with read-replicas and promote a local read cache; circuit-breaker with controlled fallback behavior.
testing_plan: Unit tests for policy evaluation (100% branch coverage for edge rules)
Integration test: 3-region simulated ingress verifying allowed/rejected mirrors
Chaos test: kill policy store primary during ingestion — ensure fallback behavior and no data loss
Load test: 50k events/sec ingest with 10% cache miss rate to measure p50/p95 latency impact
Compliance test: synthetic tenant with EU-only policy should never have events in non-EU clusters during advisory+strict phases
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (pilot): Enable advisory mode for 10 high-volume tenants in staging and prod-east for 2 weeks
Phase 1 (regional pilot): Enable advisory for all tenants in EMEA region clusters and monitor for 7 days
Phase 2 (soft-enforce): Enable soft enforcement for selected customers with contract clauses (per-customer opt-in)
Phase 3 (enforce): Flip to strict enforcement for all tenants in geography after 6 weeks with rollback window and support on-call assigned
Rollback: feature-flag off restores previous fan-out behavior; reconciliation job will surface any missed replicas for manual remediation
monitoring_and_alerting: Metric: rps of RPS cache misses and Postgres consult latency
Metric: p95/p99 ingestion latency per region and per tenant
Alert: reconciliation.detected_cross_region_copy > 0 => P0 pager after 1 occurrence for strict-mode customers
Dashboard: residency-compliance per-tenant timeline and last-violation event with signed audit blob link
Alert: RPS primary write errors > 5% for 5m => oncall paging
